title.narrative: Emerging technologies, related repositories and digital tools, connectivity.

description.narrative: The relevance of technology in enhancing the resilience of education was revealed during the longest disruption on education in recent time because of COVID-19. Many Countries, including Nigeria resolved to leverage on technology to ensure learning continues, however, most nations were not adequately prepared for the new mode of teaching and learning. Major constraints observed include inefficient use of digital platform for teaching and learning, non-availability of ICT policy for education and pedagogy, with instances of some digital learning contents not adhering to appropriate curriculum and pedagogy by levels of education. While some privileged learners had access to learning devices, household with low economic resources had limited to access to education during the period due to the cost of acquiring learning devices and internet. Soft technology like literacy by radio was leveraged to bridge this gap to some extent. As emergencies are not evitable and in the context of advancing AI, it is important to increase support to Nigeria to begin to digitally transform its education for resilience, upscaled access and quality. Therefore, within this output, UNESCO Abuja will build on the support provided to the government of Nigeria within the GPE project to enhance the operationalization of ICT policy for Education, coordinate engagement with stakeholder on harmonizing and enhancing teaching and learning platforms and support the government to mobilize partnership and investment in technology for learning and ensure digital divides are bridged.
